_note: 學習路徑內容第22批 #6／6：片語介系詞 because of／in spite of／instead of（eng.t_adv.prep.phrasal-prep，學測級／高階）。片語介系詞由多字組成，後接名詞或 -ing、不接完整子句；because of + 名詞 vs because + 子句；in spite of = despite（= although），但 despite 後不加 of；instead of = 代替。誘答鎖『because 接名詞／despite of／片語漏 of／片語介系詞誤接完整子句／instead 當介系詞用／語意混淆原因↔讓步↔代替』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix php_）。

units.title_zh: 片語介系詞（because of／in spite of／instead of）
units.can_do: 我能正確使用片語介系詞（because of／in spite of／despite／instead of），後接名詞或 -ing，並分辨 because of（接名詞）與 because（接子句）、despite 後不加 of。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Phrasal (multi-word) prepositions are followed by a noun or an -ing form, not a full clause: 'because of the rain', 'instead of walking.'
claims.verification_ref: 片語介系詞後接名詞或 -ing、不接完整子句（because of the rain、instead of walking）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'because of' is followed by a noun, but 'because' is followed by a full clause (subject + verb): 'because of the storm' vs 'because it stormed.'
claims.verification_ref: because of + 名詞、because + 完整子句（because of the storm / because it stormed）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'in spite of' and 'despite' mean the same (= although) and are followed by a noun or -ing; note 'despite' has NO 'of' after it: 'in spite of the cost' = 'despite the cost.'
claims.verification_ref: in spite of = despite（= although）後接名詞/-ing、despite 後不加 of（in spite of the cost = despite the cost）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'instead of' means 'in place of' and is followed by a noun or -ing: 'tea instead of coffee', 'instead of complaining.'
claims.verification_ref: instead of = 代替、後接名詞/-ing（tea instead of coffee、instead of complaining）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Phrasal prepositions are prepositions made of more than one word. They are followed by a NOUN or an -ing form, not a full sentence. We stayed home because of the rain.
teach.zh_hint: 片語介系詞由多個字組成，後面接名詞或 -ing，不接完整句子。We stayed home because of the rain.（我們因為下雨待在家。）

teach.body: We stayed home because of the rain.
teach.zh_hint: 我們因為下雨待在家。because of 後接名詞 the rain。

teach.body: 'because of' takes a noun; 'because' takes a full clause (subject + verb). Compare them. She was late because of the traffic.
teach.zh_hint: because of 接名詞；because 接完整子句（主詞＋動詞）。比較兩者。She was late because of the traffic.（她因為塞車遲到了。）

teach.body: She was late because of the traffic.
teach.zh_hint: 她因為塞車遲到。because of + 名詞 the traffic。

teach.body: 'in spite of' = 'despite' (= although), and 'instead of' = 'in place of'. Note: 'despite' has no 'of'. We went out in spite of the cold.
teach.zh_hint: in spite of 等於 despite（＝although）；instead of 等於 in place of（表『代替』）。注意：despite 後面不加 of。We went out in spite of the cold.（我們不顧寒冷出門了。）

teach.body: We went out in spite of the cold.
teach.zh_hint: 我們不顧寒冷還是出門了。in spite of + 名詞 the cold。

practice.stem: 選正確：The game was cancelled ____ the heavy rain.（比賽因為大雨取消了）

distractor_rationales.because: because 後要接完整子句（主詞+動詞）；後面是名詞 the heavy rain，要用 because of。
distractor_rationales.so: so 表結果、放在兩句之間，不接名詞片語表原因。
distractor_rationales.although: although 表讓步（雖然），語意不符『因為』。

practice.feedback: because of the heavy rain：because of 接名詞表原因。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ the bad weather, they finished the hike.（儘管天氣不好，他們還是走完了）

distractor_rationales.Despite of: despite 後面不加 of；要用 despite 或 in spite of。
distractor_rationales.Although: although 後接完整子句（主詞+動詞），後面是名詞片語 the bad weather，要用 Despite／In spite of。
distractor_rationales.Because of: because of 表原因，但句意是『儘管天氣不好仍完成』的讓步，要用 Despite。

practice.feedback: Despite the bad weather…：despite 後接名詞、不加 of。

practice.stem: 選正確：Let's take the stairs ____ the elevator.（我們走樓梯，不要搭電梯吧）

distractor_rationales.instead: instead 是副詞，單獨用時後面不接名詞；接名詞要用 instead of。
distractor_rationales.because of: because of 表原因，不符『代替』的意思。
distractor_rationales.in spite of: in spite of 表讓步（儘管），不符『代替』的意思。

practice.feedback: the stairs instead of the elevator：instead of 接名詞表『代替』。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ complaining, she offered to help.（她沒有抱怨，反而主動幫忙）

distractor_rationales.Instead: instead 後不直接接 -ing；接 complaining 要用 instead of。
distractor_rationales.Despite of: despite 後不加 of；且語意是『代替』不是『儘管』。
distractor_rationales.Because: because 後接完整子句，且語意不符『代替抱怨』。

practice.feedback: Instead of complaining…：instead of 後接 -ing，表『沒有…反而…』。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（儘管很累，他還是完成了工作）
practice.answer: In spite of his tiredness, he finished the work.
options: In spite of his tiredness, he finished the work.
In spite his tiredness, he finished the work.
In spite of he was tired, he finished the work.
Despite of his tiredness, he finished the work.

distractor_rationales.In spite his tiredness, he finished the: 片語是 in spite OF，不能漏掉 of。
distractor_rationales.In spite of he was tired, he finished th: in spite of 後接名詞或 -ing，不接完整子句 he was tired；可改 in spite of being tired 或 although he was tired。
distractor_rationales.Despite of his tiredness, he finished th: despite 後不加 of；要用 despite 或 in spite of。

practice.feedback: In spite of his tiredness…：in spite of 後接名詞、三個字齊全。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: They played outside in spite of the cold weather.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：played outside、in spite of（三個字）、the cold weather、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。片語介系詞連讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: We stayed inside because of the storm.
lines.intonation: because of 連讀、storm 句尾下收

lines.text: She chose water instead of soda.
lines.intonation: instead of 連讀、soda 句尾下收
